question: What happens when Tārā is well worshipped?
premises: The verse says Tārā is well worshipped.
It says all the moving world is destroyed.
inference: Well worshipping Tārā leads to destruction of all the moving world.
uncertainties: Whether destruction is cosmic or ritual is not specified.
plain_english: Having well worshipped Tārā, he destroys all the moving world.
